environment: PGlite isolated catalog; not Supabase hosted

policies.qual: ((published AND (published_at <= now())) OR ( SELECT is_admin() AS is_admin))
((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR esports_can_review(id))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM esports_applications a
  WHERE ((a.id = esports_status_events.application_id) AND ((a.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR esports_can_review(a.id)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_teams t
  WHERE ((t.id = training_team_invites.team_id) AND (t.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM training_team_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = training_team_participation.session_id) AND private.team_member(s.team_id, ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
